name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return; 0 means all remaining lines

name: write
description: Create or replace a file in the workspace

name: edit
description: Replace unique text fragments in a workspace file. Pass old_text and new_text for one replacement, or edits for several applied together against the original file. When old_text has no exact match, a match that ignores trailing whitespace and treats curly quotes, dashes, and non-breaking spaces as ASCII is used, and only the part of old_text that new_text changes is rewritten.

edits.description: Non-overlapping replacements, each matched against the original file

old_text.description: Existing text to replace; it must occur exactly once in the file
Existing text to replace; it must occur exactly once in the file

name: ls
description: List one level of a workspace directory (read-only)

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to list; defaults to .

name: find
description: Find workspace files by glob pattern (read-only). Files the workspace's .gitignore excludes are skipped unless no_ignore is set

no_ignore.description: Search files the repository's .gitignore excludes; defaults to false

path.description: Workspace-relative directory or file to search; defaults to .

pattern.description: Relative glob pattern; supports recursive ** segments

name: grep
description: Search workspace file contents with a regular expression (read-only). Files the workspace's .gitignore excludes are skipped unless no_ignore is set

glob.description: Optional relative file glob; supports recursive ** segments

ignore_case.description: Match without case sensitivity; defaults to false

no_ignore.description: Search files the repository's .gitignore excludes; defaults to false

path.description: Workspace-relative directory or file to search; defaults to .

name: skill
description: Load a skill's instructions by name, or read a file inside that skill's directory. Call it before starting a task that matches a listed skill.

file.description: Optional relative path of a file inside the skill directory

name.description: Skill name from the available_skills listing

name: bash
description: Execute a shell command from the workspace

name: memory_search
description: Search remembered facts and preferences for the current user and workspace

query.description: Search terms; empty lists recently active records

name: remember
description: Propose a fact or preference to remember; a human reviews it before it takes effect

base_revision.description: Revision of the record being updated, from memory_search

key.description: Stable key for updating this record later

kind.description: Record category, e.g. preference, instruction, fact

target_id.description: Existing record ID, from memory_search, when proposing an update

name: forget
description: Propose forgetting a remembered record found via memory_search; a human reviews it before it takes effect

scope_id.description: Scope ID of the record, from memory_search

scope_namespace.description: Scope namespace of the record, from memory_search

description: Start a sub-agent on a self-contained task and return immediately with its task id. The sub-agent runs in parallel with you, has its own context (fresh unless context is "inherit"), the same workspace and file tools, and receives follow-up parent task updates only when you call agent_send. Its final report arrives later as a [task-notification] message. Use agent_wait when you need the result before continuing, agent_status to check progress, and agent_send when the user adds constraints, priorities, facts, or direction changes for a queued or running task. Put the initial goal, relevant paths, constraints, and requested report format in prompt; pass agent to use a named definition from the Agents list.
name: agent

agent.description: Name of a definition from the Agents list in the system prompt: it sets the sub-agent's instructions, tool set, and default model. Omit for the default sub-agent.

context.description: How the sub-agent starts. fresh (default, or the definition's setting): it sees only prompt. inherit: it also receives a copy of this conversation up to this call. Prefer, in order: (1) fresh with a self-contained prompt: goal, paths, constraints, what to report back; (2) fresh, with the context you already obtained pasted into prompt (file excerpts, tool output, decisions), so the sub-agent skips the tool calls that produced it; (3) inherit, when that context is too large or too scattered to paste and the sub-agent would otherwise repeat expensive tool calls. A sub-agent never shares your prompt cache, so inherit costs one full uncached pass over this conversation per sub-agent, and everything irrelevant to the task goes in with it.

description.description: Short label (<= 80 chars) shown in status output.

model.description: Provider model id for the sub-agent. Default: this session's model. Otto does not validate it; an id the endpoint rejects fails the task with the provider's error. Overrides the definition's model.

name.description: Optional task name, unique in this session; usable instead of the task id in agent_wait, agent_status, and /task. 1 to 64 letters, digits, '_' or '-'.

prompt.description: The complete task; the sub-agent sees nothing else.

wait.description: Block until the task ends and return its result instead of its id.

name: agent_wait
description: Wait for a sub-agent task to finish. With task_id, waits for that task; without it, waits for every task that is queued or running. Blocks up to timeout_seconds (default 600, max 3600) and returns each task's completion report. Errors if the wait times out or is canceled, naming the tasks still running, or if task_id is unknown.

task_id.description: Task id or name; omit to wait for every queued or running task.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait, in seconds. Default 600, max 3600.

name: agent_status
description: Show sub-agent task status. Without task_id, one line per task in this session: id, status, elapsed time, and current activity or token total. With task_id, that line plus the task's recent steps and, once finished, its result or error.

task_id.description: Task id or name; show one task's detail, including its recent steps.

name: agent_send
description: Send a task update to a queued or running sub-agent. Use this when the user adds constraints, clarifies priorities, provides new facts, or asks the child to adjust direction. The child reads updates at the next safe checkpoint; this does not interrupt an in-flight provider or tool call. It cannot be sent to a finished task.

message.description: The task update, clarification, new fact, or direction change to deliver to the sub-agent.

task_id.description: Task id or name of the queued or running sub-agent.
